name: PRESCRIPTION_DETAILS_EXT
description: This table stores prescription information for orders that are sent to an external system via an interface.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the order record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: DISPENSE_DURATION
columns.description: This item stores the dispense duration when Ordering by Duration.
